title: A paid Space membership tier can be saved below the price floor, because the floor check is never called

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: lib/billing/membership-tier-price.ts:12 says NOT YET WIRED. isValidTierPrice and membershipTierPriceError have no caller outside tests, and setMembershipTiers (lib/spaces/memberships.ts) has no check, so a $0.50 paid tier saves, and Stripe fees exceed it. THE FIX: call membershipTierPriceError in the tier write and return its message.
